tagline: Kohs cube puzzles for children: rebuild each picture from two-color squares
privacy_description: Privacy Policy for Samsquares, the spatial reasoning puzzle game for children. The app collects no data.
summary_nothing: Samsquares collects no data. Nothing about you or your child leaves the device.
summary_offline: The app works fully offline. It makes no network connections of its own.
summary_no_ads: No ads, no analytics, no tracking, no accounts and no in-app purchases.
summary_local: Stars and settings are kept only on the device.
about_1: Samsquares (the “app”) is a puzzle game for children, made by MathOutsideTheBox and built and maintained by Ariel Tkachenko (“I”, “me”).
about_2: This policy explains what the app does with information. It applies to version 2.0 and later. Earlier versions used Google Firebase for anonymous usage statistics and crash reports; version 2.0 removed it.
collect: None. The app doesn't ask for names, email addresses, ages or any other personal information, has no sign-in, and doesn't record or send how it's used. There's no analytics, advertising or tracking code in the app, and it doesn't use the advertising identifier.
device_intro: To work, the app keeps a little information in its own storage on the device:
device_stars: Stars earned for each puzzle, so the game knows which puzzles are solved.
device_settings: Settings: music and sound effect volume, haptic feedback and which game hints have been shown.
device_outro: This stays on the device and in its iCloud or computer backups, if you make them. I have no access to it. Clearing a level or all levels in the app's Settings removes the stars; deleting the app removes everything.
third_parties: The app contains no third-party code. Apple distributes it through the App Store, under Apple's privacy policy. The About screen has a link to email me and a link to the website of the game's music; both open only when you tap them, in the Mail app and in Safari.
children: Samsquares is made for children, which is one reason it collects nothing. It has no chat, no sharing, no ads and no purchases, and nothing a child does in the game is sent anywhere.
changes: If the app ever starts handling information differently, this page will be updated before that version is released, with a new date at the top.

support_description: Help and contact for Samsquares, the spatial reasoning puzzle game for children.
support_summary: Email me with any question, problem or idea. Please mention your device and iOS version if something doesn't work.
a_play: Each puzzle shows a picture made of squares. Drag squares from the row under it onto the empty grid to build the same picture. Squares with two colors can be turned: tap one in the row or on the grid to rotate it a quarter turn. When the grid matches the picture, the puzzle is solved.
q_stars: How do I earn three stars?
a_stars: Every solved puzzle earns a star. A second star comes from finishing within the level's time limit, and a third from solving without extra moves: one drag per square and no square turned all the way around.
a_mirror: In the Mirror levels you build the picture as it would look in a mirror: the left side becomes the right side. The game explains it before the first mirror puzzle.
q_unlock: Why can't I open some puzzles?
a_unlock: Puzzles open one after another: solve a puzzle to open the next one. Solved puzzles can always be played again, and replaying never lowers the stars you already have.
q_reset: How do I start a level again?
a_reset: Open Settings (the gear in a level's puzzle list) and choose Clear level, or Clear all levels to start the whole game again.
q_sound: How do I change the music, sounds and vibration?
a_sound: The note button turns all sound on or off. Settings has separate controls for the music volume, the sound effects volume and haptic feedback.
a_progress: Stars are saved on the device and kept when the app is updated, including from version 1. They aren't shared between devices. They're included in the device's backups, and they're removed if the app is deleted.
